active_count.description: Number of agents currently in an admissible state.
active_count.expected_behavior: Should decrease over time as agents hit forbidden nodes or residue barriers.
failure_modes: Unexpected zeroing out due to overly aggressive rules.

mean_residue.description: Average number of steps taken by active agents.
mean_residue.expected_behavior: Should increase monotonically for surviving agents.
failure_modes: Negative values or lack of growth.

active_history.expected_behavior: Used to calculate the residue seeding time constant (tau_R).
